'''Z-Theta Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that defected to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|rogue government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|forces]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In the [[Zaarin insurrection]], they fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] but were ultimately defeated.
